findings.failure_path: Budget exhaustion no longer stops automatic reviewer calls; it triggers a checkpoint after which 'another necessary bounded sequence' is permitted. The only record of cumulative spending is continuation_basis=existing-task-scope in a caller-owned task artifact, and the same paragraph forbids adding it to CLI arguments or runtime receipts. The controller is stateless, so an agent can start a fresh chain with fresh bindings, obtain a new five-round budget, and no gate, receipt or consuming validator can observe that a prior chain was exhausted. The gated party self-adjudicates the checkpoint and the artifact; omitting the artifact entirely is undetectable.
findings.smallest_fix: Require the new sequence to bind the prior terminal receipt through the existing --predecessor-chain-result-file mechanism (or an equivalent controller-visible cumulative-round field) so the restart is machine-checkable, instead of recording continuation only in an unverifiable caller artifact.

findings.failure_path: validate_finding_dispositions accepts disposition="source_refuted" for any finding regardless of severity, and the only substantive requirement on evidence is a distinct, control-character-free string of 1..1000 bytes. An implementer whose external review returned P0 findings can write one sentence per occurrence and complete: main() emits status passed, completion_gated false, completion_basis=source_refuted_findings, and the downstream validator (consumer_basis_source_1) accepts that basis. No external party ever agrees the finding was refuted, so a genuinely unresolved P0 reaches the completion gate through a purely self-adjudicated path.
findings.smallest_fix: Reject source_refuted dispositions for P0/P1 findings (require a renewed external round for those severities), or require each such disposition to cite a packet byte-offset/line that the gate verifies against the bound candidate.

findings.failure_path: The automatic-review trigger is defined by the agent's own classification of the diff ('an implementation diff triggers this transition'), with the exempting categories — read-only investigation, status answers, design-only work — decided by the same agent. Combined with the SKILL.md description change, the reviewed outcome is reachable by classifying a code change as non-implementation; step 4 additionally lets the agent record a user skip with no external artifact. Nothing in the changed diff makes the classification or the skip machine-checkable, so bypass-by-omission leaves no trace.
findings.smallest_fix: Require the classification to be backed by the recorded change-inspection command output already demanded in the reporting paragraph, and state explicitly that a non-empty implementation hunk in that output overrides any narrative classification.

findings.failure_path: When the model sends malformed packet-tool arguments, the server already returns an isError result and the model can legitimately retry (the retry case is tested for 'packet chunk starts beyond end'). But any text starting with 'invalid packet' makes the parser return inconclusive with reason_code tool_boundary_violation and cascade_eligible false, discarding an otherwise completed, byte-verified review and blocking fallback to another reviewer. A single schema slip by the model destroys the lane rather than being treated like the other recoverable argument errors.
findings.smallest_fix: Treat 'invalid packet ...' results like the other verified error results (allow the call and let the model retry), reserving tool_boundary_violation for a server/tool name outside the allowlist.

findings.failure_path: The codex stub's help branch was relaxed to match any 'exec ... --help', so no test asserts that `codex exec` itself advertises `--disable shell_tool`. The wrapper proves the capability only via `features list --disable hooks --disable shell_tool` — a different subcommand. If a real Codex build supports the feature key but not the exec flag, exec fails after the capability probe passed, and no test in this suite would catch the regression that the probe and the invocation check different surfaces.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the stub's help output flag-sensitive and add a check that the wrapper falls back inconclusively when `codex exec --help` does not list `--disable shell_tool`.

concern_results.conclusion: Found credible bypasses on all three axes. (a) Source-refutation completeness: validate_finding_dispositions binds occurrences and hashes but places no constraint on severity or evidence checkability, so an implementer-authored free-text string closes an external P0 and yields exit 0 / status passed / completion_gated false, which the downstream consumer accepts as completion_basis=source_refuted_findings. (b) Bounded packet lifecycle: local re-execution of read_chunk/search_packet does bind returned bytes, but any single malformed model argument aborts the whole lane as inconclusive+cascade_eligible false, and item.completed is accepted with no preceding item.started so pending-call emptiness proves nothing about lifecycle. (c) Inherited authority vs explicit limits: the exhaustion checkpoint replaces awaiting_human, while continuation_basis is explicitly forbidden from CLI arguments and runtime receipts, so cumulative spending across restarted chains is invisible to the stateless controller and self-adjudicated by the gated party. I do not accept round-1 disposition (2): the cited 'trusted host must retain the ledger' sentence predates this change and does not compensate for a new rule that deliberately keeps the continuation record out of every machine-checkable surface.

Highest-risk transitions are the completion pass and the review-continuation grant, both now reachable without any external party. Literal paths to the gated outcome that skip the trigger: (1) complete --finding-dispositions-file with every disposition set to source_refuted over any severity; (2) claim the diff is not an implementation diff under development-completion.md step 1 and skip review entirely — no executable check exists; (3) restart a chain after review_chain_invalid with fresh bindings and continuation_basis recorded only in a caller-owned artifact, resetting the observable five-round bound. Packet tool containment itself (shell_tool disable, MCP list verification, byte re-verification) is materially stronger than before and I found no workspace-escape path in it.

challenge_focus: Challenge source-refutation completeness and downstream consumption, bounded read-only packet lifecycle, and inherited task authority versus explicit user limits. Trace any actionable failure through the full supplied source and tests; independently challenge the first-round dispositions.
